entries.note: x402 added sellers, not volume: a third-party tracker counts 1,200 listed services (+419 in 30 days) and 5.9M settlements/$2.4M in 30 days, yet an October report finds 91 businesses earning over $100 (+13) on $793k organic volume, down 32%. The x402 Foundation named an executive director Oct 1, citing 50+ members (40 in July) — governance, not adoption. No non-vendor L402 endpoint surfaced; Lightning Labs shipped Wavelength v0.2.0 (vendor).
